chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim said: A trustworthy person from the Ahl al-Bayt narrated to us from Abu al-Hasan Musa عليه السلام that he said:

Enter into ihram for tamattu' in hajj—meaning on the Day of Tarwiyah—until the decline of the sun, and after al-'Asr, and after al-Maghrib, and after the later al-'Isha', and all that in between is expansive.

key_terms.أَهِلَّ: to enter into ihram and begin the pilgrimage rite with talbiyah
key_terms.الْمُتْعَةِ: tamattu', the hajj form combining 'umrah and hajj with a release between them
key_terms.وَاسِعٌ: broad and accommodating in legal allowance
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah, the Day of Tarwiyah

ai.seo_question: Until what time can a person enter into ihram for mut'ah of hajj on the Day of Tarwiyah?
ai.summary: This hadith states the time window in which a person may still enter into ihram for mut'ah of hajj on the Day of Tarwiyah. It indicates broad allowance in these times, showing flexibility in the valid period for joining tamattu' hajj.
